summary: Frontend-only regression for Rummy Rewards feature (signup_bonus / min_withdraw). All 10 flows PASSED: admin login, /admin/dashboard nav, /admin/apks load, session persistence after hard reload, Add-App dialog opens with rummy defaults pre-filled (signup_bonus=₹51, min_withdraw=₹100, version=1.0.0, size=45 MB, rating=4.8, downloads=500000, developer=Uonogamesapk, rummy description, features, requirements, permissions, badge=Hot), creating an app with only App Name succeeds, new app renders on public store card with 'Bonus ₹51' + 'Min W/D ₹100' chip (data-testid=app-rewards-<id>), detail page renders detail-rewards cards with both values, editing signup_bonus→₹75 and min_withdraw→₹200 persisted after re-open, and cleanup DELETE via confirm-delete-btn removed the seed row.
critical_code_review_comments: AppsManager.jsx is a single 200+ line file with all form fields inline; consider extracting Rewards / General / Media / Advanced blocks into sub-components for maintainability (non-blocking).

openEdit spreads EMPTY over the existing app which is correct for missing fields, but if backend returns null for signup_bonus/min_withdraw the null overrides the ₹51/₹100 defaults; today backend defaults handle it — keep in mind if backend model changes.
AuthContext uses localStorage token (no httpOnly cookie). Fine for this app scope, but note there is no XSS-hardening; document in security notes.
No visible loading skeleton on /admin/apks initial mount other than a spinner; acceptable but a subtle UX gap.
seed_data_creation: Created one test app 'TEST_Rummy_X_Auto' (id 6a5377ee7eff960eef2ccc12) and DELETED it at end of test via the delete-app-<id> + confirm-delete-btn flow. Store left clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature works end-to-end. Playwright script pattern in this iteration reliably interacts with React controlled state (page.fill on Radix Input works; use data-testid selectors, force=True on RippleButton clicks, and Escape to close Dialog). Public store home renders the app card with rewards chip in the max-w-[480px] mobile column; use scroll_into_view_if_needed to reach the newly created app card.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues reproduced. Prior test agent reported inability to update React state via page.evaluate; the fix was to use Playwright's page.fill on the [data-testid] input directly (works with Radix's controlled Input) instead of setting .value via evaluate.
